title: Swaps
statementMd:
You are given two integer arrays a𝑎 and b, both of length n. In one operation, choose two adjacent elements of the current array a. If their sum is a multiple of 3, swap them.

Determine whether a can be transformed into b using any number of operations, including zero.

## Input

Each test file contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases T (1≤T≤1000). The description of the test cases follows.

The first line contains an integer n (1≤n≤5⋅105).

The second line contains n integers a1,a2,…,an (0≤ai≤109).

The third line contains n integers b1,b2,…,bn (0≤bi≤109).

For each test file, it is guaranteed that the sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 5⋅105.

## Output

For each test case, print `Yes` on a separate line if a can be transformed into b, and `No` otherwise.

## Note

In the first test case, swapping the first two elements gives the target array, since 1+2=3.

In the fourth test case, the middle element cannot be swapped with either neighbor, so the two end elements cannot be exchanged.
